name: splat04
description: SPLAT 04 — the future's messiest professional sport.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @splat04/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @splat04/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @splat04/server dev" "pnpm --filter @splat04/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @splat04/shared build && pnpm --filter @splat04/web build && pnpm --filter @splat04/server build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @splat04/shared build && pnpm --filter @splat04/shared test && pnpm --filter @splat04/server test
